data.why: The app reads only precomputed bundles already checked into data/demo (catalog.json, models.json, attribution.json, model_evolution.csv, network_layout.json/network_nodes.parquet, pv_response_s1.parquet, and per-event folders under data/demo/events/ with satellite frames, PV, AC-reference and GENCO power-flow parquet files); nothing needs to be generated.

goals: Watch a real cloud-clearing event unfold and see how satellite-derived PV output ramps as clouds clear
Compare AC power-flow reference states against GENCO model predictions (zero-shot, generator-aware, response-aware) for the same grid event
Assess whether a grid foundation model's predicted import responds correctly to PV changes versus the physical AC reference
Trace the model evolution from zero-shot checkpoint through successive adaptation stages on error and response metrics
Inspect the reconstructed Sundon distribution network topology, loads and assets underlying the simulated states
Check data provenance and licensing for each layer (observed satellite imagery, derived PV, simulated AC states, predicted GENCO output)

review.summary: The tree states the app's purpose correctly: checking whether GENCO checkpoints reproduce the AC reference's response to real cloud-driven PV changes. Its phases follow the app's pages in a sensible order, the specific labels are accurate, and most cited screens show what the nodes claim. It needs a few fixes before filing: drop the theme-toggle task, fix f2's link to a task that doesn't exist, add the plant-against-no-plant counterfactual and network inspection, and replace two screens taken mid-rerun.
